entities.name: Yannis Papadimitriou
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: John K. Papadimitriou was a Greek archaeologist. Along with George Mylonas, he excavated Grave Circle B, the oldest known monumentalized burials at the Bronze Age site of Mycenae.
